lore.projectredacted.0.title: Incident Log, Site-[REDACTED]
lore.projectredacted.0.body: Day 1: Every site went dark at once. O5 command is not answering. We are told to hold position. Day 3: Nobody is coming.
lore.projectredacted.1.title: Memo: Containment Priorities
lore.projectredacted.1.body: With the Mainframes down, automated containment has failed across the network. Prioritize Keter-class. Abandon everything else if you must.
lore.projectredacted.2.title: Torn Page
lore.projectredacted.2.body: ...it wasn't one breach. It was all of them, the same night, like something flipped a switch. The GOC say they didn't do it. The Hand say they warned us.
lore.projectredacted.3.title: Personnel Notice
lore.projectredacted.3.body: All surviving staff proceed to the nearest Foundation Bunker. Bunker doors respond to Level 4 credentials only. Wait for a Site Director.
lore.projectredacted.4.title: Field Report
lore.projectredacted.4.body: The Insurgency hit the convoy at dawn. They didn't want the guards, they wanted what was in the trucks. Three anomalies unaccounted for.
lore.projectredacted.5.title: Letter, Never Sent
lore.projectredacted.5.body: If you find this, I'm sorry. We kept them in boxes for so long we forgot the boxes were the only thing holding the world together.
lore.projectredacted.6.title: Engineering Note
lore.projectredacted.6.body: C.A.S.S.I.E. runs on her own circuit. If the Mainframe goes, she keeps talking. Whoever rebuilds: install her first.
lore.projectredacted.7.title: Wondertainment Flyer
lore.projectredacted.7.body: Has the end of the world got you down? Dr. Wondertainment's Little Misters are still only 4 low payments! Find our friendly Sales Representative today!
